name: Dubbo

what_it_is.fact: Dubbo is a city of 43,516 people (June 2021) in the Orana region of the NSW Central West, at the intersection of the Newell, Mitchell and Golden highways, about 400 km by road from Sydney. It is the largest population centre in Orana.

whyVisit_candidates.reason: Cycle or drive round an open-range zoo
whyVisit_candidates.fact: Taronga Western Plains Zoo opened on 28 Feb 1977 on 300 ha of woodland and irrigated grassland; it is open-range with concealed moats instead of fences. Wikivoyage lists elephants, giraffes and rare black rhinos (a breeding program). Bike, electric cart and pedal boat hire is on site.
whyVisit_candidates.photo_candidate: Giraffes at Taronga Western Plains Zoo.jpg (accepted by skeptic.json, 2700 px)

whyVisit_candidates.fact: Old Dubbo Gaol was an official gaol from 1859 to 1966 and is now a museum; the operator describes theatrical performances and immersive displays, with guided and self-guided tours. It won Gold, Cultural Tourism, at the NSW Tourism Awards (operator's claim).
whyVisit_candidates.photo_candidate: Old Dubbo Gaol, NSW, 2021, 09.jpg (accepted by skeptic.json, 3572 px)

whyVisit_candidates.fact: Limestone karst caves 8 km south of Wellington, with tours of three cave sites, a visitor centre and Discovery Lab (operator). Fossil bones of a diprotodon and giant kangaroo were found in the caves in 1830; tours of Cathedral Cave began about 1885; the phosphate mine reopened for tours in 1996. Wikivoyage lists Wellington Caves as a Dubbo day trip.
whyVisit_candidates.photo_candidate: Wellington Caves, Wellington, NSW, 2022, 17.jpg (accepted by skeptic.json, portrait 2891x3855)

goodToKnow_candidates.tip: Getting there: Dubbo is about a 4-hour drive west of Sydney (roughly 400 km by road). An XPT train runs daily from Sydney, usually arriving 2-3 PM, and Dubbo is one of the few regional NSW towns practical without a car because stays are walkable from the station and the zoo is a 5 km taxi or bus ride. Regional Express and QantasLink fly from Sydney.

Zoo logistics: it is 300 ha, open every day of the year; Zoo Circuit 9:00 AM-4:00 PM, Savannah Visitor Plaza 8:30 AM-4:00 PM. Hire bikes, electric carts or pedal boats on site (a cycleway, the Tracker Riley Cycleway, runs from town); buy tickets online, where an adult is listed from $51.30 against $57.00 at the gate.

Heat and day trips: summer highs often exceed 40 C (Jan mean max 33.6 C), so do the zoo early or in cooler months. Wellington Caves are 51 km away off the Mitchell Highway, tours run 9:00 AM-4:15 PM daily; book tours via the caves site and allow a half day with the drive.
